name: Gul'dan's Prodigy lowers Fel Fireball's cost and cast time by 15% (#875)
contract: Gul'dan's Prodigy 704378 effect 1 (misc=14, SPELLMOD_COST) and effect 2 (misc=10, SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME) are both SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with EffectBasePoints=-16, DieSides=1, so their real percentage is -16+1=-15 each. Their classmask (family 20, dword1 bit0) matches Fel Fireball (e.g. 801312) by SpellFamilyFlags. SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost and the cast-time calculation apply SPELLMOD_COST/SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME generically, so Fel Fireball's cost and cast time both drop by 15%.
